items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: when I saw Stella, she used to come to my house... We used to have something called Blue Monday at my house... she'd come up sometime.

ctx.x: At one time. Yeah, at one time, yeah.

And, um, but, uh, um, when I saw Stella, she used to come to my house. With this drummer, um, they used to, they used to take around quite often to see the town and, uh, they used to come to my house. I was living on Liberty, uh, uh, Irana and Liberty. My people used to own that corner. And we used to have something called Blue Monday at my house. And we used to pay the money. The musicians used to come down and, uh, my wife would cook. And we'd play music all day. We used to make our cow, you know, put in, buy…
No, she's passed. She passed too, yeah.
